t: Rename Librarian → Expediter + add lug prioritization/refinement burndown role
description: Rename the Librarian advisor to Expediter across all active hub and framework files. Expand scope beyond signal→KB→teach distribution to include: lug prioritization scanning (quality score per lug), refinement queue generation, and active burndown dispatch. The Expediter is the accelerator — it makes work faster to generate in each spoke by ensuring lugs arrive already refined and cheaper to dispatch.
perceive: Read existing Librarian skill.yaml, wai.md Step 1.5, AGENTS.md table. Confirm active vs historical file distinction.
execute: Wave 1: mv directories. Wave 2: Update skill.yaml + state.json + deliver.py. Wave 3: Update wai.md, AGENTS.md, kb curator yaml. Wave 4: Add prioritize_and_refine.py. Wave 5: Rename tests + tools. Wave 6: Update open lugs.
verify: grep -r Expediter hub/WAI-Hub/advisors/expediter/ returns hits. grep -r Librarian hub/WAI-Hub/advisors/ returns nothing. Hub wai.md step 1.5 references expediter/ paths. prioritize_and_refine.py exists and runs.
acceptance_criteria: wai.md Step 1.5 references Expediter paths and includes lug refinement step
prioritize_and_refine.py scores lugs by PEV quality and outputs refinement queue
No stale 'Librarian' refs in active config files (wai.md, AGENTS.md, skill.yaml)
